name: DSFR Core
description: Base services, admin pages and field tooling for the DSFR (French State Design System) module suite.
project_description: DSFR Core is the base module of the DSFR (Systeme de Design de l'Etat / French State Design System) module suite. It provides shared services, admin settings pages, and field/text-format tooling used by the sibling modules (dsfr_block, dsfr_menu, dsfr_paragraph, dsfr_twig_components) and the DSFR theme. It exposes admin pages under /admin/dsfr that report on the theme and child modules, redirect to the DSFR theme settings, and browse the DSFR icon and pictogram libraries via a bundled Preact picker. On install it relaxes the image ALT-required constraint for accessibility parity and creates a 'restricted_html_dsfr' text format with a matching CKEditor 5. The DSFR theme (drupal.org/project/dsfr) must be present for most pages to be useful.
